newsitem.title: INDIA: India says concerned over Pakistan missile reports.
newsitem.headline: India says concerned over Pakistan missile reports.

text.p: India's Foreign Ministry said on Wednesday it was concerned over reports in the Pakistani media that Islamabad was test-firing a medium-range missile, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
"We have noted with concern reports appearing in Pakistani dailies today about the test-firing of a medium-range missile by Pakistan," the news agency quoted the ministry as saying in a statement.
"Government of India is assessing the implications of these reports, in particular for our safety," the statement was quoted as saying.
Indian Foreign Ministry officials could not be reached for comment.

Pakistan, which has fought three wars with India since independence from British rule in 1947, often criticises India for its plans to develop and test ballistic missiles, particularly the medium-range Prithvi.
India has been testing the Prithvi, made in variants of 250 km (155 miles) and 150 km (75 miles), but New Delhi last month denied a report the missile had been deployed.
